chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from some of our companions, from one of them, peace be upon him.
Regarding the throwing of the Jamarat (stones), 'that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) threw the Jamarat while riding his mount.'
ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad throw the Jamarat while riding his camel?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith highlights the Prophet’s (peace be upon him and his family) practical flexibility during Hajj, demonstrating that Rami al-Jamarat can be performed while mounted. This narration serves as a primary juristic evidence (dalil) in Shia fiqh for the permissibility of throwing stones from a camel or vehicle, particularly for the elderly, the sick, or those facing crowds, thereby emphasizing ease (yusr) in religious obligations.
